content: दा I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (यच्छति, दत्त) To give, grant. --{%With%} प्रति to exchange; तिलेभ्यः प्रतियच्छति माषान् <ls>Sk.</ls> --II. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (दाति) To cut; ददाति द्रविणं भूरि दाति दारिद्र्यमर्थिनाम् <ls>K. R.</ls> --III. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (दायति) To bind (?). --IV. €3 <ab>U.</ab> (ददाति, दत्ते; ददौ-ददे, अदात्-अदित, दास्यति-ते, दातुम्, दत्त; but with आ the {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} is आत्त; with उप, उपात्त; with नि, निदत्त or नीत्त, and with प्र, प्रदत्त or प्रत्त) .²1 To give, grant, bestow, offer, yield, impart, present (usually with <ab>acc.</ab> of the thing and <ab>dat.</ab>, sometimes <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab> also, of the person); अवकाशं किलोदन्वान् रामायाभ्यर्थितो ददौ <ls>R. 4. 58</ls>; सेचनघटैः बालपादपेभ्यः पयो दातुमित एवाभिवर्तते <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 31</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 271</ls>; कथमस्य स्तनं दास्ये <ls>Hariv.</ls> .²2 To pay (as debt, fine <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 To hand or deliver over. .²4 To restore, return. .²5 To give up, sacrifice, surrender; प्राणान् दा to sacrifice oneʼs life; so आत्मानं दा to sacrifice oneself. .²6 To put, place, apply, plant; कर्णे करं ददाति <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 To give in marriage; यस्मै दद्यात् पिता त्वेनाम् <ls>Ms. 5. 151</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 146</ls>, <ls n="Y.">3. 24</ls>. .²8 To allow, permit (usually with <ab>inf.</ab>); बाष्पस्तु न ददात्येनां द्रष्टुं चित्रगतामपि <ls>Ś. 6. 22</ls>. (The meanings of this root may be variously modified or extended according to the noun with which it is connected; मनो दा to think, direct the mind to anything; नीतौ मनो दीयते) <ls>Mu. 2. 5</ls>; अवकाशं दा to give place to, make room; (see अवकाश); कर्णं दा to give ear to or listen; दर्शनं दा to show oneself to, grant audience to; शब्दं दा to make a noise; तालं दा to clap the hands; आत्मानं खेदाय दा to expose oneself to trouble; आतपे दा to expose to the sunʼs heat; आज्ञाम्, निदेशं दा to issue orders, command; आशिषं दा to pronounce a blessing; चक्षुः, दृष्टिं दा to cast a glance, see; वाचं दा to address a speech to; प्रतिवचः, -वचनं or प्रत्युत्तरं दा to give reply; शोकं दा to cause grief; श्राद्धं दा to perform a Śrāddha; मार्गं दा to make way for, allow to pass, stand out of the way; वरं दा to grant a boon; संग्रामं दा to fight; अर्गलं दा to bolt, fasten or secure with a latch; निगडं दा to put in chains, fetter; संकेतं दा to make an appointment; शापं दा to curse; वृत्तिं दा to enclose, fence in; अग्निं, पावकं दा to set on fire, <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (दापयति-ते) To cause to give, grant, <ab>&c.</ab> --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (दित्सति-ते) To wish to give, <ab>&c.</ab>
